title: Singular partitive demonstratives
focus: Choose tätä, tuota or sitä for a singular partitive reference.

exercises.prompt: Nearby.Complete “I drink this coffee.” Juon ____ kahvia.
exercises.explanation: Use tätä for this nearby reference, tuota for that farther reference, and sitä for it or that already mentioned, in the partitive pattern. The standard written partitive form of tämä is tätä; learn this pronoun form directly.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular partitive demonstratives: form or use confused

optionFeedback.tätä: Use tätä for this nearby reference, tuota for that farther reference, and sitä for it or that already mentioned, in the partitive pattern. The standard written partitive form of tämä is tätä; learn this pronoun form directly.
optionFeedback.tuota: tuota indicates one farther reference. The visible cue instead requires tätä: one nearby reference.
optionFeedback.sitä: sitä indicates one already-mentioned reference. The visible cue instead requires tätä: one nearby reference.

sentenceExplanation.translation: I drink this coffee.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: verb + partitive demonstrative agreeing with the following noun + singular partitive noun used as the object of the action

parts.role: verb
parts.formation: juon comes from juoda: juo- + -n.

parts.role: partitive demonstrative agreeing with the following noun
parts.formation: The standard written partitive form of tämä is tätä; learn this pronoun form directly.

parts.role: singular partitive noun used as the object of the action
parts.formation: This i-word keeps i: kahvi + a = kahvia. The back vowel a determines the ending.
